title: Chemistry-infused bandit drives autonomous discovery of hydrogen evolution catalysts
summary: An interpretable decision-making bandit, guided by a human chemistry-informed hypothesis of a locally quadratic relation between synthesis conditions and activity, was coupled to a fully automated electrochemical platform exploring a 12-dimensional space for the hydrogen evolution reaction. The campaign discovered previously unreported earth-abundant electrocatalysts that the authors describe as at least comparable to Pt-based ones, and the bandit produced model-derived hypotheses on how synthesis conditions affect performance. The abstract reports no numbers, and the Pt comparison is the authors' statement.
